family: R2-N1 neutral: score-threshold tiers on frozen v30 isotonic-4 x {1x, dd_guard}
hypothesis: Filtering the frozen v30 isotonic-4 signal set to higher expected_net_percent scores (known at signal time, causal past-only) may improve the monthly-geometric/DD frontier. Tiers were tried on v42 outputs by Codex but never on v30-iso4 + dd_guard; that narrow combination is the honest novelty. Exploratory only.
tier_note: t030 equals the base policy minimum (0.3); frozen minimum signal is ~0.311 so t030 is a near-passthrough that verifies base-policy == control. t040 = base+0.1pp, t050 = base+0.2pp. Filter rule: keep signals with score >= tier (score known at signal time, causal). ohlc_fill_score NOT used for filtering (base policy minimum_fill_score 0.25 already satisfied by all frozen signals, min ~0.364).
control: unfiltered control_1x must match published isotonic_4 exposure1.0 normal (+122.80% total_return, -20.09% max_drawdown, 65 trades) or STOP
dd_guard_reference: UNFILTERED-control (control_1x) sampled equity (trade exit_time/equity_after), past-only 1-microsecond cutoff, 100.0 seed level; each branch applies the guard state at its OWN signal times. Disclosed deviation from v03 (which used own-book equity per branch): single shared reference keeps tiers comparable.
